nodes.label: Mid-rental vehicle swap with optional maintenance block
Swap keeps pricing and dates unchanged (vehicle substitution, not re-quote)
Rationale: maintenance block defaults to today→+7d, not the rental end date
Candidate rate shown for the rental's own period tier (daily/weekly/monthly)
Candidate triage: Booked (hard block) vs Maintenance (soft warning) vs Free
Pay-as-you-go rentals search availability with a null end date (open-ended)
Accounts-receivable ageing by customer (0-30/31-60/61-90/90+ buckets)
Worst-bucket severity icon derived client-side from the highest non-zero bucket
Report-type → reporting-view dispatch with 50-row keyset pagination
Gotcha: ReportFilters imported from '@/pages/Reports', a path that no longer exists
Rationale: cast view_customer_statements to any until generated types are refreshed
Gotcha: reports hardcode '$'/en-US instead of the tenant's currency_code
Totals are per-page only, not a query-wide aggregate
Per-report column schema (key/label/type) driving both header and cell formatting
Reusable no-results empty state with clear-filters escape hatch
Server-side report export (CSV/XLSX/PDF) via the generate-export edge function
XLSX arrives base64-encoded and is decoded to bytes before blob download
PDF export is offered only for the customer-statements report
Tenant-scoped report filter options (customers, vehicles, payment types, statuses, date range)
Payment-type and status vocabularies are hardcoded in the client, not read from the DB
Third-party vehicle-owner payout CSV export
Owner payouts bypass generate-export and build/quote the CSV in the browser
Outstanding balance derived client-side as net_owed minus amount_paid
Date filter matches overlapping payout periods (period_end >= from, period_start <= to)
Report tile with hover-revealed per-format export affordances
Pre-export preview: first 10 rows plus an applied-filters summary
Customer review history surfaced inline during booking approval decisions
Client-side average/count fallback when the AI summary row is missing
Full per-customer review history with deep link to the reviewed rental
Reviews are fetched only while the dialog is open (customerId passed as undefined when closed)
Internal 1-10 customer rating with tags, comment, skip and edit
Copy states the rating is internal only — never shown to the customer
Free-form tags promoted into the tenant's shared review-tag vocabulary on the fly
Review dialog impression is written to the audit log on open
Skipping records a real is_skipped review row rather than leaving no record
Rental review card with three states: none, skipped, reviewed
Rental-list review column: pending / reviewed / skipped affordance
Only rentals with status 'Completed' are reviewable; others render an inert dash
Rating colour thresholds reimplemented inline instead of calling getRatingColor
Shared rating→colour scale (>=8 green, >=5 amber, else red)
Weekly/monthly installment plan configuration (payments per unit)
Rationale: tenants.installments_enabled is the flag checkout actually reads; plans alone do nothing
Rationale: merge into existing installment_config JSONB — a full replace silently wiped fields owned by other settings pages
Rationale: portal TenantContext omits installment_config from its SELECT, so settings read via useRentalSettings (SELECT *)
Rationale: a disabled <fieldset> blocks nested controls for mouse and keyboard while leaving saved config untouched
Only rental base, taxes and service fees are splittable; insurance, deposits and delivery are always upfront
Client-side sample installment schedule generator for the operator preview
Master toggle saves instantly; plan toggles require an explicit Save changes press
Markdown rental-agreement template authoring with variable insertion and live preview
Rationale: preview mirrors the full-page editor by injecting the render-time Bonzah addendum, so operators see what is actually sent
{{variable}} placeholder contract shared with agreement rendering and sample data
Bonzah onboarding file upload to a draft folder with 7-day signed preview URLs
Storage path is tenant-scoped: {tenantId}/draft/{field}/{timestamp}_{sanitisedName}
Rationale: storage delete failure is non-fatal — the file is still removed from local state
Bonzah insurance partner onboarding wizard (10 steps, submit-once)
Rationale: DB draft is the cross-device source of truth, localStorage is the instant/offline fallback
Rationale: draftLoadedRef gates saving so the empty default form cannot overwrite a stored draft before hydration
Training acknowledgement and server-graded quiz must both pass before submission
On submit, draft files are moved from {tenant}/draft/ into {tenant}/{submissionId}/ and re-signed for 30 days
Pending/approved submissions lock the form; rejected ones fall through so the tenant can re-apply
